audit_items.proof_trace: `_verifyCanSupplyTokens` (L854) enforces `amount == totalTokensAllocated`, ensuring the contract holds exactly T tokens for distribution. Each investor's claimable amount is cryptographically fixed by the Merkle leaf `keccak256(abi.encode(investor, amount, positionId, vestingConfig))`, and the `hasSettled` flag (set L285, checked L739) blocks double-claiming — making sum(claimed) ≤ T by construction.
